1. Localization
    As the game currently has languages other than English machine translated, I’d like to have other languages properly localized after Early Access.
    
2. More Accessibility Settings
    Such as Controller Support and Rebind Keys, and more.
    
3. Cat Dress up
    You can buy accessories for your cat! 
    
4. More decorations

5. Achievements

6. Balancing

7. Quality of Life Improvements

8. And More
